# Project Language

This project uses PHP, not Python or JavaScript. Write the scraper, data processing pipelines, helper scripts, and validation tooling in PHP. Do not introduce Python, JavaScript, or Node.js implementations or dependencies for project code.

# PHP Naming

Use snake_case for project-owned PHP variables, parameters, functions, and methods, not camelCase. Preserve names defined by PHP and third-party APIs, and keep class names and namespaces unchanged.
